text: PROPOSED, awaiting chief approval: dedicated non-case WeightedCoverage with estimate: ScoreEstimate, conditioningWeight: Double, coverage: Coverage. support is coverage.fraction; weight renders separately. Construction distinguishes zero observed leaves -> Missing(AllMissing), observed leaves with zero total weight -> Missing(Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight)), positive weight -> Observed(numerator/weight). Production-path discriminator: same eligible count, weight sum, and numeric value but one heavy observed leaf versus two light leaves; coverage alone differs. Projection must preserve count support and conditioning weight. Public vocabulary addition requires chief/ADR approval before implementation.
